name: Wayne Art Center Summer Art Camp
description_short: Weekly art camp at Wayne Art Center for ages 4 to 17, built from morning, afternoon and late afternoon classes in drawing, painting, ceramics, sculpture, photography, cooking, jewelry and more, each week on a theme from American art. Families make a full day by booking a morning and an afternoon class plus the supervised lunch period. A current Wayne Art Center membership is required to enroll.
refund_policy_summary: Withdrawals 10 or more days before a class get a credit (not a refund) less a 20% fee, valid one year; nothing within 10 days or after the class starts. Transfers 10 or more days ahead cost $25. Classes cancelled by the center are refunded.
notes: 2026 class times: mornings 9:30 to 12:00, Lunch Bunch 12:00 to 12:30 (full day campers only, bring a nut free bag lunch), afternoons 12:30 to 3:00, late afternoons 3:30 to 5:00. Class prices are not shown on the camp pages. A current child or family membership (September 1 to August 31) is required for every camper, so there is no non-member rate. Registration closes 1 pm the Friday before each week.
